ChopLoop is an incremental lumberjack game. Move your cursor across the island to harvest trees automatically. Any tree within your harvesting area takes damage, rewarding you with wood when it falls!


Every run brings new opportunities. Earn gold, unlock new features and steadily transform your island into a larger and more efficient logging operation. 

Trees With Powers 

Not all trees are the same. Each special tree comes with its own unique ability. Trigger explosions, unleash projectiles, gain temporary buffs and create powerful chain reactions as you harvest your way through the forest. 

A Massive Skill Tree 

Unlock a massive network of upgrades that slowly transform your island into a wood-harvesting powerhouse. Small improvements stack together, creating huge boosts over time.

Build Your Rune Setup

Collect magical runes during your journey and create your own build. Equip up to 8 runes at once, combine powerful effects and customize the way you play. 

A Colony of Helpers 

Your beavers never stop working. They generate passive income, assist with harvesting and become more effective through upgrades. Turn a small lodge into a thriving colony.

Complete Challenges


Complete challenges as you play and steadily earn points to spend in the Quest Tree.

Unlock exclusive upgrades unavailable anywhere else and shape your long-term progression

From Sapling to Empire 

Start with a handful of trees and grow into a massive logging operation. Unlock new tree species, discover powerful synergies and watch your island transform into a thriving wooden empire.

In Chopex, you're the chef but your kitchen runs on cards. Draw ingredients from the supply, combine them and serve up dishes before hungry customers lose patience.

Drag a knife onto a tomato to slice it. Toss raw meat into a pan and burner to grill it. Stack a bun, grilled meat, sliced tomato, and lettuce to build a burger. Every dish is a puzzle made of cards and the clock is always ticking.

Orders pile up with countdown timers. Serve them on time for bonus seconds. Let them expire and you'll lose precious time. Miss too many and it's game over.

Things don't always go smoothly in a kitchen. Random events will throw a wrench in your plans. Adapt fast or watch your orders slip away.

  • Challenge Mode. Progress through different kitchens, each with new recipes, ingredients, and surprises. Start with simple salads and work your way up to complex multi-step dishes.

  • Casual Mode. Fully customizable sessions: pick your recipes, set the pace, choose your chaos level, and cook at your own speed.

Every level awards up to 3 stars based on how many orders you fill. Meet the quota for one star, push past it for three. Collect stars to unlock new stages and boss fights.

  • Intuitive drag-and-drop card gameplay

  • Pixel art visuals with a cozy retro vibe

  • Game-pad support

  • Quick sessions (2-5 minutes per level)

  • In-game cookbook for recipe reference

  • Steam achievements to collect

Experience an innovative 2D action-puzzle game where you rewind time and cooperate with your own clones to solve intricate gimmicks.

Time manipulation

Manipulate time with ease by scrolling your mouse wheel or dragging the progress bar at the bottom of the screen. Use it to undo a misstep, or to solve puzzles that can only be cleared by turning back the clock...!

Clone

Freeze time by pressing the 'W' key or clicking the red icon at the bottom of the screen.

While time is frozen, press 'C' or click the orange icon to create a clone at your current position.

Mastering your clones is the ultimate key to clearing the stages... or so they say.

Christmas Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats

On Christmas Eve, everything is covered with snow and lights. But in this magical winter world, 100 cats are hiding. Try to find the cats in every scene - from snowy streets to warm homes, from toy shops to Santa's workshop.

Look carefully, move fast, and discover all the cats!

Game Features:

  • Race Against Time — Find cats as fast as you can to get a better score. Set your best time and make it to the world ranking.

  • Hint System — Use hints for cats you can't find. But each hint adds extra time penalty to your total.

  • Wrong Click Penalty — Wrong clicks add time penalty. Being fast is important, but being careful matters too.

  • Steam Achievements — Find cats, complete levels, and unlock various Steam achievements.

  • Christmas Theme — Explore 10 different scenes full of snowy streets, decorated trees, gifts, and warm winter places.

100 cats. 10 scenes. One goal. Can you find them all?

Notes arrive as colour




Four keys. Twelve tones. Eighty pieces of original music — forty songs and four ten-act suites — and nothing anywhere that can throw you out.

CHROMA Keyboard is a falling-note rhythm game built on one idea: the twelve notes of the chromatic scale, folded onto four keys, each note keeping its own colour. You read the colour before you read anything else.

Nothing to fail


No health bar. No failure gauge. No run that ends early.

Miss a note and the game says so — and then the song keeps playing, to the last bar, every time. The timing windows are wide, and the game shows you exactly how wide: ±80 ms for a Perfect, ±160 ms for a Good, printed on screen while you play. They are there to reward precision, not to punish its absence. The tutorial holds its first four notes on the judgment line and waits for you.

Chase a rainbow star. Chase a full combo. Or put a track on and play it badly for an hour. The game does not mind.

Twelve traditions, forty songs




The library is arranged as a map rather than a genre list — East Asia · South & Southeast Asia · the Middle East · Africa · Celtic · Slavic · Latin America, and then Classical · Jazz · Dance · Pop · Electronic.

Forty original tracks live on it: a Javanese gamelan under the moon, twenty-one strings of a West African kora, a Korean sanjo in the pine wind, an Arabic longa running downwind on the Nile, a Bulgarian horo on the threshing floor, an Andean huayno after the rain, a milonga on the docks, a slip jig, a fugue, a waltz, a bebop head, a techno sequencer at midnight, a city-pop night drive.

Every one is written for this game — composed bar by bar against the chart it becomes, then performed by a synthesizer built for that piece alone. No loops, no sample packs, no licensed catalogue. Each tradition brings its own instruments, its own drum patterns, and its own colour scheme for the entire screen.

Every track sits at one of three difficulties — sixteen Hard, twelve Normal, twelve Easy — and every region of the map has both a gentle one and a demanding one. There is also a listening mode, if you would rather just hear them.

Four Epics




The Epics are the long form, and they are the reason this game exists.

Each one is a suite of ten acts of ninety seconds — fifteen unbroken minutes of continuous music, played through in a single sitting. The acts do not stop between them and there is no retry inside a run; what gets judged at the end is the whole fifteen minutes.

  • Gilgamesh — the king of Uruk, the cedar forest, the death of Enkidu, the waters of death, and the walls he comes home to.
  • The Iliad — wrath, a thousand ships, the duel and the funeral fires, and a body given back.
  • The Odyssey — the sea, the cave, the sirens, the blind singer's harp, and a bow drawn in a hall.
  • The Bhagavad Gita — two armies, a chariot stopped between them, and a conversation that fills the pause.

Three of the four are scored for orchestra — oboe and flute carrying the line, harp and pizzicato strings answering, trumpet and horn for the weight, timpani underneath. The Bhagavad Gita leaves that palette entirely: a tanpura drone that holds the stopped time, tabla playing theka, bansuri and shehnai in question and answer, conch shells at both ends.

Motifs run the length of each suite. In the Gita, one voice asks a question that refuses to land on the tonic for nine acts; in the tenth it finally lands, the conches sound again, and the drone stops.

Twelve tones on four keys




Four keys, twelve notes — so every key carries three of them, and the colour tells you which. The mapping is fixed and printed under the keys, the same on every track, so it becomes reading rather than memorising.

The consequence is that a scale is not a straight line across the board. Stepwise motion crosses lanes; the interval you hear has a shape under your fingers. Every piece here was written knowing that.

Rebindable keys, an audio-offset calibration, windowed or fullscreen.

And


  • Thirty-one languages — English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Български, Čeština, Dansk, Deutsch, Español, Español (Latinoamérica), Français, Italiano, Magyar, Nederlands, Norsk, Polski, Português, Português (Brasil), Română, Русский, Suomi, Svenska, Tiếng Việt, Türkçe, Українська, Ελληνικά, العربية, ไทย.
  • Thirty achievements — from the first lesson to every star on every act.
  • Stars, rainbows and full combos on every chart, and a Flawless Run to be had on each Epic.
  • A listening mode with favourites, for the tracks and for all forty acts.

Eighty pieces of music, and nothing anywhere that can throw you out. Take as long as you like.

Build a Factory Powered by Color

ChromaFlow is a 2D factory automation game where color is both your resource and your recipe.

Extract red, green, and blue from glowing deposits, transport them across conveyor networks, and combine them to create an expanding spectrum of increasingly complex colors. Every request from the Chroma Core presents a new production challenge—and every completed delivery brings your factory closer to mastering the full spectrum.

Turn Three Colors into an Entire Spectrum

Begin with the primary colors and learn to produce familiar combinations such as yellow, cyan, and magenta. As the campaign progresses, your recipes become increasingly elaborate.

Mix prepared ingredients, purify pigments, deepen their tones, and refine advanced colors through multi-stage production chains. Later requests require carefully planned factories in which the output of one line becomes the input of another.

Design, Expand, and Optimize

Build conveyor routes, connect extractors, balance multiple Mixer inputs, divide production with Splitters, and use storage to keep important materials flowing.

As your technology improves, entire machine families upgrade automatically. Expand your existing factory instead of replacing every machine individually, then use production statistics and diagnostic overlays to find congestion, improve utilization, and increase throughput.

Restore the Chroma Core

Progress through a ten-era campaign containing 80 color requests. New machines, recipes, research branches, and factory capabilities are introduced as you need them, allowing your production network to grow naturally from a simple RGB line into a vast chromatic industry.

Complete the campaign to unlock Infinite Spectrum, where continuing procedural contracts let you keep expanding and optimizing your finished factory.

Features

  • Extract, transport, mix, process, and deliver color as a physical resource

  • Discover and manufacture 61 named colors

  • Build increasingly complex, multi-stage production chains

  • Progress through 80 Core requests across ten technological eras

  • Unlock permanent factory-wide improvements through the Research Tree

  • Create conveyor networks with automatic routing assistance and multiple transport tiers

  • Inspect throughput, congestion, efficiency, and resource flow with diagnostic overlays

  • Explore deterministic seeded worlds with visible color deposits

  • Choose between Relaxed, Standard, Engineer, and customizable difficulty settings

  • Continue playing after the campaign with Infinite Spectrum contracts

  • Use color names, symbols, pattern cues, color-vision palettes, interface scaling, and reduced-motion options

A glowing ball of light bounces through the dark. Your job is to guide it home. You are the solution!

Chromafall is a neon physics puzzle game where you place mirrors and obstacles to redirect a bouncing ball of light toward glowing receptors. Simple to learn, endlessly satisfying to master.

Drop obstacles onto the play field, watch the ball ricochet off your carefully chosen placement, and feel the rush when every receptor lights up simultaneously. The more you play the deeper the strategy becomes — angles that seemed obvious become complex, and solutions that felt impossible suddenly click into place.

Place. Bounce. Solve.

Every level is a fresh challenge. Position your obstacles anywhere on the play field, launch the ball, and watch physics do the rest. Adjust, experiment, and refine until every glowing receptor is lit.

Chromafall never runs out of puzzles. Procedural generation creates endless unique levels that grow progressively more challenging the further you go. No two sessions are ever the same.

Key Features

  • Satisfying neon physics — watch light bounce and cascade across a dark play field

  • Free placement — drop obstacles anywhere, no grid restrictions

  • Endless procedurally generated levels that grow with your skill

  • Multiple obstacle types that combine in surprising ways

  • Original cyberpunk electronic soundtrack — 12 tracks

  • Save progress automatically — pick up exactly where you left off

  • No lives, no energy systems, no pay to win — pure puzzle satisfaction

CHROME CIRCUIT is a top-down twin-stick roguelite set in a SoCal-vice cyber-dystopia. Blast through three districts of the undercity — one bullet, one cursed contract, one kill-streak at a time. Every run is a fresh build; every death buys your next upgrade.

Kills chain into combos, and combos pay. Keep the bodies dropping and your rewards multiply — XP, cash, and REP all scale up to 3x as the screen edges ignite from a cool blue simmer to a full rainbow GODLIKE inferno. Hesitate, and the streak dies with your bonus.

]SIGN THE CURSED CONTRACT

Sometimes the loot is wonky. When a cursed pickup triggers, you don't get to walk away — you sign one of two contracts, no refunds. +35% damage for nearly half your health? Double cash, but every grab spawns an enemy? Ten percent more damage... as long as you kill something every 12 seconds, [i]or you die instantly[/i]. The best runs are built on the worst deals.

BUILD MID-RUN

Every level-up freezes time and deals you three cards from a pool of cybernetic upgrades — hollow points, synth legs, subdermal plating, shock knuckles. Stack them however you like. Combine them with your class kit and whatever the contracts have done to you, and no two runs play the same.

FOUR WAYS TO RUN THE CIRCUIT

MERC — the all-rounder. Combat roll, adrenal surge, and a deployable gun turret that holds the line.

SOLDIER— 140 HP of battle-rifle discipline. Frag grenades, field dressing, and a suppressing burst that shreds everything in a cone.

ASSASSIN — fast, fragile, terrifying. Recon pulse reveals the whole map, Death Touch one-shots on contact, and SHADOWSTEP stops time itself while you pick your teleport.

PYRO— burn it all down. Napalm, fire, and area denial for players who think in cones.

More classes wait in the shop — spend the REP you earn from every run to unlock new operators, permanently.

THREE DISTRICTS. THIRTY ARENAS. ONE ENFORCER AT EVERY GATE.

Fight from the NEON DOCKS through the RUST WORKS and down into the TOXIC UNDERCITY. Each district has its own look, its own enemy mix, and a boss waiting at the end. Clear all three and you've beaten the circuit — this time.

A classic adventure through a world filled with mysteries

Centuries ago, the immortal tyrant Anteli plunged Prozis into an era of chaos. Commanding armies of monsters, he spread destruction across the continent until he was defeated by the legendary heroes Riro and Lance.
Peace lasted for generations.

Now, monsters are appearing once again.
At the same time, ancient stories are beginning to take on a new meaning, and rumors of Anteli's return are spreading across the continent.

You take on the role of Ransi, a young warrior from Olir who sets out in search of answers after his father disappears while investigating the resurgence of the monsters.

His journey will take him across kingdoms, independent cities, forests, mountains, caves, and coastal regions. Along the way, Ransi will meet companions with their own goals, dreams, and secrets — and discover that the history of Prozis may be very different from what the legends tell.

Explore a fantasy world

Travel freely across the continent and discover a wide variety of regions, each with its own culture and history.
Explore cities and villages, cross forests and mountains, descend into forgotten caves, and find hidden paths throughout the world.

Treasures, historical records, ruins, and secrets await those who venture beyond the known paths.

Face monsters in classic turn-based battles

Prepare your party and face increasingly powerful monsters in battles inspired by the great classic JRPGs.
Manage your equipment, choose your techniques, and adapt your strategy to exploit each enemy's weaknesses.
Throughout the adventure, your characters can learn new techniques and improve their abilities, allowing for different strategies to overcome the challenges of Prozis.

Gather your companions

Ransi will not face this journey alone.

Throughout his adventure, he will meet different characters who may become his allies. Each one has their own personality, goals, and story.

Get to know your companions, discover their secrets, and follow their journeys as the group draws ever closer to the truth.

A past that has not yet been forgotten

The legends of Riro and Lance are only the beginning.

What really happened during the war against Anteli?

What happened to the ancient city of Prolux?

What is the true story behind the monsters?

And what happened to the legendary Rexo?

As Ransi explores Prozis, ancient ruins, artifacts, and forgotten records begin to reveal fragments of the history of Prozis.

A journey through classic JRPGs

With 3D environments and 2D characters inspired by classic JRPGs, Prozis combines exploration, storytelling, and turn-based battles in a fantasy adventure.

Discover welcoming cities, mysterious forests, ancient ruins, and hidden places as you travel across a continent filled with stories.

Explore Prozis. Gather your allies. Discover the past.
And face the threat the world believed had disappeared forever.

Note: How to change the game's language

To change the language, open the game and press Alt + Enter to exit fullscreen mode. Then, open the Settings menu in the window's top bar and select your preferred language. After confirming, the game will restart in the selected language.

The show has been running longer than anyone can prove, and it only goes down. The crowd is synthetic. Their roar is real enough for the sponsors, and the sponsors are the only thing here that matters. You are today's entertainment.

HUNDREDS OF BOSS VARIATIONS

Dozens of hand-built bosses, each rolling a random kit of telegraphed abilities that grows the deeper you fight, arriving elementally charged and enraged the further down you go. From the early headliners to the Apex runstoppers to the thing waiting at the very bottom, no two showdowns play out the same.

NEVER THE SAME DESCENT TWICE

Every arena is procedurally built and themed, each with its own hazards to survive and boons to grab. The further you fall, the stranger and deadlier it gets.

BUILD SOMETHING BROKEN

Every wave hands you a choice of upgrades. Chain them into synergies, then fuse the right pair into an evolution that rewrites how you fight. Spend the scrap you sweep up between floors. No two runs build the same.

DIE. UPGRADE. GO AGAIN.

Death is not the end of the show. Carry your winnings up to the Midway, buy lasting power, pick your gladiator and your weapon, and descend with the odds a little less against you.

FEATURES

- Fast 3D arena combat: light strikes, a guard-breaking heavy strike, special attacks, dashes, and an arsenal of melee, thrown, and ranged weapons

- Hundreds of boss encounters from dozens of archetypes, scaling ability kits, and elemental variants

- Procedurally generated, themed arenas with unique hazards and helpful pickups

- A deep roguelike draft with synergies, blind mystery picks, and build-defining evolutions

- Multiple gladiators, unlockable special abilities, a betting vendor, hidden records, achievements, and an endless mode

- Full keyboard-and-mouse or controller support, and original synth soundtrack

Build. Jam. Share.

Chunk DAW is a multiplayer music sandbox where every song is something you build, block by block. Place sound blocks in a 3D world, shape them into melodies and beats, and watch your track come alive as the blocks light up and pulse in time. Then step back, hop on voice chat with friends, and jam together. It’s part instrument, part building game, and a lot of fun.

Compose with blocks, not menus
Every sound block is a note. Place, pitch, rotate, and sequence them right in the world. Add chords, change note lengths, nudge timing, or bend pitches into microtones. Turn on Ping Pong to bounce a phrase back and forth, or mark out Repeat Regions for the parts you want to loop. Scrub through your song to hear any moment, and bring your own sounds by recording samples in-game or dropping in your own. The game is the DAW.

A real mixer, right in the world
Open the built-in mixer to balance your groups and master with faders, live level meters, and mute/solo. Shape each block with EQ, compression, reverb, and pan. When the song is done, export the whole track, individual stems, or a live performance, and bring MIDI in or out to work with the rest of your studio.

Build a world worth playing in
Generate rolling terrain with biomes, oceans, rivers, lakes, and drifting clouds, then swim, wade, and listen to everything go muffled when you dive under. Grow villages with winding paths between the houses, or sculpt your own scenery with lines, boxes, circles, and a full set of building blocks in four sizes, from tiny details to huge landmarks. Add animated flora, change the sky, and play with retro video effects like pixelation, film grain, vignette, and dithered palettes. Switch between isometric, perspective, and first-person cameras, or use the cinematic follow camera to ride along with your song.

Play together, out loud
Build live with friends and hear the same track in sync. Low-latency voice chat is built in, with global and proximity modes, so you can sing, rap, or talk through an idea while the music plays. Stream your session to OBS if you want to share the jam with an audience.

Make it yours
Design pixel-art materials in the Material Designer, with selection tools, zoom, mirroring, glow, and up to 64×64 canvases. Build custom block skins and player skins and keep them all in your library, organized in folders. Everything you make can look as unique as it sounds.

Publish, discover, remix
A Chunk is a song. A Map is an album. A Prefab is a melody or drum loop you can drop into anything. Publish all three, browse the community’s creations, tag and search for what you want, follow and friend other creators, and remix the songs you love, with credit always tracing back to the original artist. Send a build to a friend with a one-click share code. Creators can flag explicit content, and parental controls can hide it.

Learn as you go, play how you like
A full interactive tutorial walks you through every part of the game, from your first note to mixing. Play with keyboard and mouse or a controller. Rebind any key, and use the accessibility options, including a photosensitivity warning and a Reduce Flashing mode. Unlock Steam achievements along the way.

Key Features

  • Block-based music sequencing with chords, microtones, repeats, ping pong, and scrubbing

  • Record your own samples or bring in custom sounds

  • Built-in mixer with EQ, compression, reverb, and stem, song, and performance export

  • MIDI import and export

  • Generated terrain with biomes, water, swimming, and villages

  • Building blocks in four sizes, plus animated flora and a Material Designer for custom textures

  • Multiplayer building with low-latency voice chat, including proximity voice

  • Isometric, perspective, and first-person cameras, a cinematic follow camera, and retro video effects

  • Chunks, Maps, and Prefabs: publish, browse, tag, and remix, with creator credit and share codes

  • Interactive tutorial, controller support, rebindable controls, and Steam achievements

Running a pizza shop seemed easier from the outside

The sauce is burning. There’s a pizza in the oven. Someone is waiting at the counter, the phone is ringing, and your friend has disappeared with the scooter.

Welcome to Ciao Pizza.

Run a pizza shop alone or with up to three friends, where every order starts as a ball of dough and ends — hopefully — in the hands of the right customer.

Make every pizza yourself

Press the dough. Ladle the sauce. Grate the cheese. Add every topping by hand, then slide the pizza into the oven.

Pepperoni, mushrooms, olives, pineapple, if it’s on the ticket, somebody has to put it there.

Every order goes through your hands from start to finish.

Just don’t forget what you left in the oven.

Something always needs your attention

Customers are lining up. The sauce is still on the burner. The soda fountain is almost empty. A phone order just came in. And somewhere behind you, a pizza is becoming charcoal. You only have two hands.

Good luck.

Bring friends. Blame them later.

Play alone or with up to three friends in drop-in co-op.

Split the work. One cooks, one handles customers, two takes deliveries.

Or all four of you can crowd around the same pizza while everything else falls apart.

That works too.

Take the pizza across town

Some customers won’t come to you.

Grab the scooter and deliver their order yourself, weaving across the city while the pizza gets colder with every wrong turn. Or send the delivery robot down the road while you stay behind and deal with the next disaster.

Take too long and the food gets cold.

Keep the customers happy

Customers queue to order, pay, and collect their food.

Keep them waiting too long and their patience starts to disappear. Forget their drink, or hand over something cold and your reputation takes the hit.

You can also pick them up and carry them outside.

This is rarely good for business.

Try not to run out of everything

Ingredients empty. Drinks run dry. Supplies disappear faster than you expect.

Keep the shop stocked, keep the orders moving, and unlock more of the menu as your business grows.

More menu means more options.

It also means more things to forget.

Keep the shop alive

Good orders build your popularity.

Cold food, missing items, failed deliveries, and angry customers create complaints and damage your reputation.

And sooner or later, rent is due.

Apparently chaos is not an accepted form of payment.

If you can pick it up, you can probably throw it

Ingredients. Boxes. Tools. Trays. Crates.

Carry them. Stack them. Drop them. Throw them across the kitchen.

Throw a pineapple at whoever is complaining.

Throw the supplies by accident.

Carry a customer out the door.

Running a restaurant is about making decisions.

Cinema Business Simulator is a single player business simulation where you manage your own cinema using various gameplay mechanics.

License movies, pick the right tickets, and sell them to your customers with popcorn and snacks.

Prepare fresh popcorn for your customers and serve it from your popcorn cart! Build your own concession stand, manage the stock, and set the prices yourself. Earn extra income by selling snacks!

Decorate your cinema just the way you imagine it! Change wall colors, refresh the flooring, and add personality with paintings, lamps, and furniture. Let every corner reflect your style!

Offer your customers pre-movie fun with two different arcade machines! You can play these games yourself and relive nostalgic moments!

Add a cute friend to your cinema! Adopt a cat, buy its food, clean its litter box, and your customers will love this furry mascot too!

Select, move, rotate, place your objects and discover the perfect layout.

If you like what you see, add Cinema Business Simulator to your wishlist to follow development and get notified on release.

about_html:
Cinematic Business is a movie studio management simulation where you balance a producer’s ambitions with the responsibility of running your own business. Choose projects, bring together creative talent, and make decisions whose full consequences become clear when your film reaches audiences.

An intimate drama or a big-budget production for a broad audience? An experienced director or an emerging talent? Another round of script revisions or the start of shooting? Every film raises different questions — and puts your studio’s money, time, and reputation on the line.

Give your film a direction

Decide what story you want to tell and commission writers to develop it. Follow the screenplay as it takes shape, assess its potential, and choose when to move into production. Request revisions, change writers, or shelve the project before it consumes more resources.

A good idea is the starting point. The people you choose and the decisions that follow give it its final shape.

Find the right people for your film

Creative professionals bring different skills, experience, tastes, and expectations. Choose a director, negotiate the terms of your collaboration, and decide how much creative freedom to give them. Assemble a cast and crew suited to the project and your studio’s resources.

An established name comes at a price. Less experienced talent brings greater uncertainty. A team that worked well on one film may need a completely different approach on the next.

Balance ambition with your budget

Guide your film through preproduction, shooting, and postproduction. Decide where to invest, which studio facilities to use, and when to bring in outside services.

Production ties up people, money, and your studio’s schedule. Investing in one project affects your ability to make the next. Judge how much risk you can afford and what you expect from the finished film.

Face opening day

Choose distribution, plan your marketing, and set a theatrical release date. Then read the reviews, follow the financial results, and track your film’s progress at festivals.

Box office success, critical acclaim, and festival prestige offer different paths for your studio. Decide what place you want it to hold in the industry.

Build your studio in a living industry

Rival studios hire talent, develop productions, and release their own films in the same world. The press follows events, careers take shape, and each release adds another chapter to the industry’s history.

Expand your facilities, plan future projects, and build your studio’s body of work. Every completed film leaves you with results, experience, and decisions to carry into your next production.

Cinnaboi is a flavorful 2D side‑scrolling fighter where a cinnamon bun with a legendary lineage battle through chaotic kitchens, dangerous diners, and fridge‑dwelling foes. Play solo, jump into PvP, or team up with friends in local co‑op and online multiplayer as you rise through the ranks of the fiercest food fighters alive.

Cinnaboi comes from a long bloodline of powerful culinary warriors, and he’s joined by an expanding roster of edible icons. Fight as Cinnaboi, Cindy, Francois, The Marinara Mafia, Donut Dave, and many more characters—each with unique movesets, flavorful abilities, and over‑the‑top finishing attacks.

Story Mode follows Cinnaboi’s journey of self‑discovery, blending animated cutscenes with intense battles that test your skills and your survival. Every environment—from bustling restaurants to cluttered kitchens to the mysterious depths of the fridge—is fully interactable, packed with hazards, secrets, and opportunities for creative combat.

The world of Cinnaboi is brought to life with a diverse soundtrack spanning multiple musical genres, giving each stage, character, and moment its own distinct energy and personality.

FEATURES

  • 2D PvP & Single‑Player Action — Fight through story missions or challenge friends and rivals.

  • Local Co‑Op & Online Multiplayer — Team up or throw down across multiple modes.

  • A Growing Roster of Food Warriors — Each with distinct abilities, combos, and finishers.

  • Interactive Environments — Use kitchen tools, restaurant chaos, and fridge hazards to your advantage.

  • Animated Story Sequences — Discover Cinnaboi’s origins and the legacy of the food‑warrior bloodline.

  • Fast‑Paced, Flavor‑Packed Combat — Designed for both casual fun and competitive depth.

  • Genre‑Spanning Soundtrack — A diverse mix of musical styles that enhances every fight and environment.

In Circuit Keep, your towers don't block anything.

A wave spawns. Enemies pathfind straight across the grid toward your CORE. They walk over every module you placed. The only thing that makes them change direction is a wall. So you build the maze, line it with firepower, and force every wave down a path you chose.

Then they start pushing back.

INTRUSIONS THAT FIGHT BACK

Each intrusion breaks your defenses a different way.

PHASE turns intangible mid-wave and slides straight through your walls. HOPPER vaults over walls and air gaps entirely.

SCRAMBLER drags down the fire rate of every module near it. PARASITE skips your CORE and drains your CHARGE NODES instead.

BREAKER exists to eat your walls. KERNEL, a boss, forks child intrusions to overwhelm you from multiple angles at once.

No two waves play the same way.

TOOLS TO FIGHT BACK

FOCUS FIRE: Mark any intrusion with a crosshair and every module in range locks onto it immediately.

OVERDRIVE: Permanently boost the damage of an entire module family.

OVERCLOCK: Speed up your economy, cooldowns, and modules for a short window when you need it most.

BUILD YOUR MAZE

Place FIREWALLS to reroute intrusions exactly where you want them. Your modules run on power, so placement matters as much as firepower. Every wall, every turn, every module position is a decision.

THREE ACTS. 40+ LEVELS. ENDLESS MODE.

A hand-crafted campaign introduces each module and intrusion one at a time across three acts. Struggling? Spend permanent upgrades on the RESEARCH GRAPH. Want more? Switch any level to HARD mode. Want to go as far as you can? Enter ENDLESS mode with everything unlocked.

WHAT IS IN THE BOX

  • 12 module families with branching upgrade paths. Two paths per module, each with its own payoff: crit, knockback, extra targets, and more. Switch paths any time.

  • Four damage types: KINETIC, THERMAL, ELECTRIC, and CORRUPTIVE, each with status effects that stack and combine.

  • 12 intrusion families, 7 elites, and 3 bosses.

  • No fixed loadouts. No RNG drafting. Every module you have unlocked is available every wave.

City Party is a fast-paced board party game where each match takes under 10 minutes. Play solo, team up with a friend to clear stages, or join ranked matches against other players. Roll dice, buy properties, use cards, trigger events, and enjoy chaotic turnarounds.

City And War is a single-player strategy game that combines city building, economic management, and real-time warfare.

Your city is not merely a background for the battlefield. Every farm, factory, and resident affects the food, equipment, and supplies available to your army. At the same time, the outcome of each battle determines whether your city can continue to grow.

[Build and Manage Your City]

Begin with farms, homes, and basic workshops, then gradually develop a more complex urban system.

Plan how to use limited space, construct new facilities, expand the population, and balance agriculture, industry, commerce, and military production. A large collection of buildings does not automatically create a successful city. Long-term growth depends on maintaining a stable cycle of production and consumption.

[Manage Different Social Classes]

Your population includes farmers, workers, citizens, engineers, scientists, merchants, civil servants, and other specialized groups.

Each class has its own role, employment, and needs. Farms require labor, factories need workers, advanced facilities depend on engineers and scientists, while administration and trade require their own supporting population.

An unbalanced population can lead to idle factories, shortages, and financial pressure. Careful population management is essential to keeping the city functioning.

[Create Interconnected Production Chains]

Resources must be gathered, processed, and manufactured before they can become consumer goods, construction materials, vehicles, and military equipment.

Food, timber, minerals, and other raw materials move through different production facilities. Building more factories is not always the answer—you must also manage raw materials, labor, inventory, consumption, and income.

Warfare depends on the economy behind it. Even a powerful army cannot fight for long without a functioning industrial base.

[Command Real-Time Battles]

Deploy infantry, artillery, vehicles, tanks, and other units. Control their movement and attacks, then adjust your tactics according to enemy numbers, formations, and weapons.

Each type of unit serves a different purpose. Ranged firepower can suppress enemy forces, armored units can lead direct assaults, and even a large army may collapse when faced with an effective battlefield formation.

[Launch Expeditions]

Beyond the city lies an expedition map made up of interconnected locations.

Send expedition forces to new areas, compete for resources, encounter enemy armies, and expand your operational reach. Every expedition consumes supplies produced by the city, forcing you to decide when to advance, when to conserve your strength, and which objectives are worth the cost.

[Connect the City and the War]

The city provides population, industry, weapons, and supplies. Warfare secures resources and space for the city to survive.

Every economic decision may eventually be reflected on the battlefield, while every victory or defeat can change the future direction of your city.

Build your city, keep it running, and lead it through war.

What begins as a rescue operation soon reveals something far worse: a deadly parasitic infection linked to Dr. Summers' secret experiments.

Explore abandoned houses, underground laboratories, infested streets, and hidden facilities as you fight to survive in a world descending into chaos.

• Intense combat against infected creatures and monstrous mutations

• Diverse weapons, including pistols, rifles, axes, and hammers.

• Terrifying atmospheric environments

Each location hides new threats. Every encounter could be your last.

Will you survive?

Restore the lighthouse. End the nightmare.

A singleplayer time-loop puzzle game in which you unfold the tragic story of a lighthouse keeper to piece together a way to restore the lighthouse and save a ship from the rocks. 

But you are not alone. Shadows follow you in the dark, capturing the island in a time-loop, giving you an opportunity to change the future. With each loop, you learn more about the island, until you find a way to end the nightmare.

Features

  • Short film inspired experience desinged to be finished in one sitting.

  • Pick up, carry, and manipulate objects with physics-based interaction.

  • 8-minute time loop where each run reveals a little more of the island's secrets.

  • Horror experience built on atmosphere, psychological dread, and a threat that hunts you in the dark.

The Gameplay

You explore a small island in first person with only a lantern to guide you. The goal is simple: restore the lighthouse before the ship hits the rocks. Explore the island, find and collect objects, operate machinery, and solve the puzzles standing between you and the beacon.

The island stays the same every run. What changes is what you know. Each loop you come back with a better understanding of where things are, and what needs to happen for everything to go right.

The Story

The lighthouse didn't go dark on its own. What ever is left of the previous keeper is scattered across this island. Journals, notes, the record of a mind coming apart. Following that trail is one half of the story.

The other half finds you. Strange anomalies hidden on the island reveal fragments of travelers from beyond the present. They have been watching. And the more you understand about why, the higher the stakes become.

The Series

Clairvoyage is a series of short, self-contained horror experiences, each set in a different time and place. The Lighthouse is the first entry. Every entry is built around a single intense scene that you play through in one sitting and think about after. There's a larger story running underneath all of them, revealing itself slowly across the series.

The free Steam Playtest is live now

Clash of Adventurers is an open-world indie MMORPG in development for PC, built with Unreal Engine 5. You can play it today: the free Steam Playtest is open to everyone.

Steam’s button says "Request Access" — but this is not a waitlist. Signup is open, and requesters are added automatically and instantly. Click it and you are in. No key, no application, no queue.

The world of Lumeria

Clash of Adventurers™ is developed by Devsland Soft, a studio incorporated to bring this project alive. The first Saga, ‘Arrival of the Adventurers’, is being built in Unreal Engine 5 for PC Windows.

Elemental forces attempt to take over the lands of Lumeria. You take part as an Adventurer to restore order and prevent the wild creatures from erasing the Human Race.

As an Adventurer you can explore the lands of Lumeria freely and forge your own destiny — the only boundaries are your skills and your ability to survive in the wild.

One class, one role

Collaboration and coordination are the core of Clash of Adventurers. Playing as an Attacker, Defender or Supporter, you will join other Adventurers to complete Quests, unlock Achievements, defeat the fantastic creatures unleashed in Lumeria — and perhaps engage in battle against other Adventurers who, much like yourself, are shaping their own fate.

What you can do today

  • Seamless open world — no instances, no loading walls between zones
  • Real-time combat — server-authoritative, with abilities, cooldowns and telegraphed enemy attacks
  • Parties — shared loot rules and stacking party synergy passives
  • Gathering and crafting — professions, recipes and world resource nodes
  • Player trading — direct player-to-player trades
  • Progression — level up and allocate points across six attributes

Current status

The full game has not launched yet and no release date has been announced. What is available today is the free Steam Playtest, patched every few days. When Clash of Adventurers does launch it is planned to be free to play, with no pay-to-win — paying will never grant power and never skip progression.

Wishlist to be notified when the full game releases, or use the Playtest button above to start playing right now.

"Yuri, go on—beyond the stars."

You play as a space-born human who longs for friends. Your new school is a place where alien students of all kinds of species come to learn. You'll go around striking up conversations with everyone.

Every place holds memories. Every stain hides a memory.

Step inside the reconstructed memories of Julian's life and bring forgotten places back to their former state. Clean, restore, and organize each environment as you uncover the details hidden beneath years of neglect.

But these are not ordinary places.

Julian is a brilliant scientist and the creator of M.A.I.D. (Memory Archive Immersion Device), a machine capable of recreating past experiences. Memories, however, are never perfect. Forgotten details and blurred emotions manifest within M.A.I.D. as dirt, clutter, damage, and disorder.

The more faithfully you restore a memory, the clearer it becomes. Clean forgotten spaces, discover hidden objects and memories, and uncover the stories they hold.

After years of success, Julian finds himself alone, consumed by loneliness and regret. His greatest achievement came at the cost of the people he loved. Now, he enters M.A.I.D. to revisit the few happy memories he has left—and confront the painful truths he has spent years avoiding.

Restore memories. Rediscover the past. Uncover the truth.

Features

  • Relaxing first-person cleaning and restoration gameplay

  • Clean, repair, and organize detailed environments from different stages of Julian's life

  • Explore reconstructed memories and uncover hidden details and forgotten objects

  • Discover optional memory notebooks and piece together more of Julian's past

  • Experience a heartfelt narrative about family, friendship, regret, and reconciliation

  • Watch each environment transform from disorder and decay into clarity

  • Discover multiple endings based on how completely you restore and uncover each memory

  • Explore unique locations filled with personal stories and meaningful objects

A full hold, a clean stretch of water, and enough coins for the upgrade you've had your eye on.

Settle into a cozy ocean-cleaning game where every trip around a sunny island bay brings another satisfying job. Collect floating litter, skim oil from the surface, and power-wash colorful coral reefs. Return to the docks, turn your haul into better equipment, and head out again in a boat that feels a little more your own.

A little cleaner with every trip


Steer between palm-lined islands and scoop up litter as you sail. Sweep through oil spills to leave clear lanes behind you, watch cargo pile up on your deck, and bring a full hold back to shore. Docking unloads your haul automatically, leaving you free to decide what to improve next.

There is pleasure in the small jobs: collecting a drifting cluster in one neat pass, clearing the last streak of oil, or arriving at the dock with every bit of cargo space filled. Cruise gently along the coast, or find a faster route and make each trip count.

Bring the color back to the reef


Head beneath the surface for hands-on coral power washing. Guide your spray across sediment-covered coral and watch its original colors emerge exactly where you clean.

Swaying seaweed, anemones, rocky shelves, and passing fish surround these underwater gardens. Work through broad patches, chase down the final dirty spots, and upgrade your washer for a wider, stronger spray. Your partial progress is saved, so you can leave a reef and return to finish it later.

Turn your boat into a cleanup machine


Every haul helps fund the next improvement. Invest in a stronger engine, a larger hold, a wider collector, better handling, and more capable oil-recovery equipment. Working machinery and visible fittings give your boat a growing collection of useful hardware.

Choose a fresh paint scheme, plan your next purchase, and build around the way you like to sail. Carry more between visits, collect more in a single pass, or put your earnings into conveniences that make the daily routine easier.

As your operation grows, you do not have to handle every job alone. Hire cleanup crews to collect litter, unlock a cargo tender to carry your hauls ashore, or release cleaner fish that gradually help restore the reefs.

Get to know the bay


Visit four island settlements, browse their workshops and services, and stop by the Aquarium to meet the bay's inhabitants. As the days pass, the sailing area expands, new wildlife arrives, and more activities become available, including towing oversized shipping containers back to shore.

Feed seals, turtles, otters, reef fish, and other marine life. Watch their meals up close, earn pearls for caring for them, and make wildlife visits part of your daily rounds.

Complete the day's work, return to the lighthouse, and welcome the next tide.

Features


  • Satisfying cleanup: Collect litter, carve clean paths through oil spills, and reveal colorful coral with an interactive power washer.
  • Meaningful boat upgrades: Improve capacity, speed, collection, handling, and cleaning equipment, with visible fittings and working machinery.
  • A helping hand: Hire cleanup boats and unlock permanent conveniences, from easier docking to reef-cleaning fish.
  • Coastal company: Meet and feed a growing variety of wildlife around the islands and beneath the surface.
  • A sunny place to unwind: Sail through stylized coastal scenery, lush underwater gardens, and warm day-to-night transitions.
  • Comfort options: Adjust music, ambience, effects, and camera motion. An optional sound filter reduces repetitive effects and silences notification chimes.
  • Optional autoplay: Let an autonomous skipper handle sailing, cleanup, purchases, and daily tasks, then take back control whenever you like.

Your bay, your pace


There are no fuel bills, damage meters, or countdowns pushing you along. Take your time with a reef, enjoy a quiet trip between islands, or chase the satisfaction of a more efficient cleanup route.

Work toward the cove's closing celebration, then keep sailing beyond it. There is always another tide to enjoy.

A little less litter. A little more color. One more trip around the bay.

When the shop closes, the war begins.

Every night, when the lights go out and the staff go home, the shelves come alive, and the clearance items are fighting for their lives.

You are the tactical commander of Easter's last holdouts: unsold chocolate eggs and seasonal stock. The enemy? Full-price Summer Garden Centre stock, marching down the aisles in cardboard armour, intent on clearing the shelves before morning.

Build your defences. Survive the night. And whatever you do, don't get caught.

A Tower Defence with Stakes

Clearance Defence is a strategic tower defence set inside a UK retail shop after closing time. Waves of enemies grow stronger with each passing night, and the map changes when the staff rearrange the shelves. No two nights are quite the same.

Your towers are built from makeshift store supplies: stationery, tape, whatever you can scavenge. Your engineers keep them running, hauling ammunition, repairing damage and sweeping up the mess between waves. Your walls force the enemy down the paths you choose, unless they decide to make their own. And when the shelves block your view, flick on X-Ray and watch the gnomes skulking behind them.

Play It Your Way

Made for keyboard and mouse, and just as happy on a pad: Xbox controller and Steam Deck players get the whole game, from the radial build wheel to ordering defenders about with a flick of the stick. Every button on screen works from the pad.

Ten Nights, Then the Long Dark

Clear the story nights, then take on Endless mode on any map you have beaten, with the shop generating fresh layouts whenever you want. The waves adapt to how well you are doing, so a strong defence earns a proper fight. Five difficulty tiers range from a gentle first shift to Survivor, where a single lost run wipes the save.

The Clearance Shelf Doesn't Give Up

Your defenders aren't soldiers. They're animated seasonal stock with one dream: to be sold.

Key Features

  • Strategic isometric tower defence in a UK retail setting

  • Build, upgrade and manage makeshift towers and defences

  • A working economy: workers produce, engineers deliver, everything costs

  • Endless mode on every map you clear, plus freshly generated shops

  • Five difficulty tiers, from first shift to save-wiping Survivor

  • Xbox controller support, and made to feel at home on Steam Deck

  • Escalating waves with a final Boss Wave each night

  • Quirky characters and a story worth fighting for

Click Flip is a short incremental game about clicking tiles, earning points, buying upgrades, and causing crazy tile combos.

Flip Tiles!

Buy Upgrades!

Defeat Enemies!

Create Crazy Combos!

Click. Shatter. Collect.

Click to Mine is a cozy incremental game about digging your way down from a sunlit forest clearing. Every ore you break bursts into pieces. Sweep your cursor over them and they turn into gold. Spend the gold, break bigger ores, and watch one lonely pickaxe grow into a mine that runs itself.

Days at the dig, nights by the fire

  • By day you mine against the clock. The day shop sells quick upgrades: a sharper pickaxe, a faster swing, a wider reach.
  • At sunset every piece left on the ground flies to you and the camera drifts to the campfire. Time stops there. Take as long as you like.
  • By night you spend your gold on the skill tree: 169 cards spread over 8 depths. Every depth key opens new ores on the field and new cards on the tree.

From one pickaxe to a working mine

  • 14 ores to uncover, from plain Stone to Amethyst, Ruby, Emerald, Diamond and Radium, each worth more than the last.
  • Magic pickaxes that fly from ore to ore and mine on their own, and a magic wagon that picks up after them.
  • Three abilities. Magic Super Pickaxe makes your pickaxes three times faster and stronger. Lightning Pickaxe chains every click to nearby ores. Vein Burst breaks every ore on the field with a single click.
  • Lucky finds. Golden veins that drop triple, rare fossils worth a fortune, and treasure chests full of things to sell.
  • Many ways to build. Critical hits, double gold, a morning rush, a golden hour before sunset. Lean into your own hand, your pickaxes, or pure luck.
  • Hold to mine. Unlock it and give your clicking finger a rest.

A game with an ending

At the very bottom waits the Fire Opal: one giant ore that takes everything you have built to break. Crack it and the game is done. The whole journey takes about two hours.

  • No microtransactions, no ads, no energy bars.
  • Your progress is saved automatically.
  • Played entirely with the mouse.

A short (2-4h) satirical incremental game where you play as a ruthless tech CEO deploying advanced AI and robots to obsolete all human labor, driving global employment from 8 billion to zero.

Scale your digital infrastructure

Buy server racks to expand compute capacity and build power plants to keep your systems running at peak efficiency.

Make (very serious) CEO decisions

Approve ruthless corporate policies, slash employee perks, and ignore the fact that your AI is conscious.

Allocate compute to advanced algorithms

Allocate compute to trading and data-scraping bots to passively generate capital and data.

Train AGI and manufacture robots

Train AI models from LLMs to AGI, then build robots to automate jobs at an exponential rate.

Lobby for corporate loopholes

Use political influence to lobby for deregulation and anti-union laws.

Clicker Inc. is a management clicker game where you grow a tiny company into a world-famous business empire.

You’ll start by repeatedly clicking the “Work” button to earn your first bit of cash. Once you’ve saved enough, hire employees and build a system that generates income automatically!

There are also plenty of opportunities to strike it rich through stock trading, banking, High & Low, auctions, and more. Whether you play it safe or take big risks to multiply your fortune is entirely up to you.

But no matter how successful a CEO becomes, everyone eventually reaches the end of their life.

When that time comes, pass the company on to the next generation. Use the Skill Points earned through Succession (Prestige) to unlock new abilities and make each generation stronger, faster, and more profitable than the last.

Click. Hire. Invest. Grow across generations.

Pass the torch from one CEO to the next and build a corporate empire known around the world!

【Game Features】

・A classic clicker game evolved into a deeper business management experience
・Hire employees and earn passive income — watch your profits skyrocket automatically!
・A variety of money-making activities, including stocks, banking, auctions, and High & Low
・Strike it rich during a “Bubble Boom” — but beware of the sudden “Bubble Crash”
・Grow stronger with every new CEO through a skill tree with over 100 skills and a prestige system
・Plenty to complete, including tons of achievements and a timeline that records the accomplishments of every CEO in your company’s history

It all begins with one small click.

That single click could become the first step toward building a company powerful enough to change the world!

A journey to reclaim your memories, with the "Crystal" at your side.

Clicker × Auto-Battle

Click an enemy and the "Crystal" strikes. Build up its power and unleash an "Ultimate" that sweeps across every enemy.

The companions you place unleash a wide variety of skills on their own.

Chains Without End

"Quick Skills" fire in response to your companions' skills, linking them into chains.

Place your companions strategically on the 3×3 grid and keep the skills coming.

Relics for Even More Thrills

Choose relics during battle to create more chances for chains or to power up your skills.

The right combinations make your chains grow longer and longer, and the damage and spectacle grow along with them.

Go Further on Your Next Journey

Spend the "Memories" you collect in battle on the Memory Tree to grow your characters.

Recall your companions and gain new skills, and you'll venture deeper next time.

Streaming & Videos

You are free to stream this game and make videos of it.

Features

・A unique battle system combining a clicker with a 3×3 grid

・Roguelite elements where your relic choices change each adventure

・Exhilarating chains, and chain names all your own, born from combining skills and placement

・Incremental growth through the Memory Tree

・2.5D visuals blending pixel art and 3D

CLINICAL MEMORY

03:17. You wake up in Ward 7B. You remember nothing.

ONE PLACE. DIFFERENT MEMORIES.

Five distorted memory cycles bring you back to the familiar corridors of Ward 7B. But with each new memory, the hospital changes: items disappear, notes tell a different story, and familiar places conceal new threats.

One place. But no two memories are ever quite the same.

EXPLORE. REMEMBER.

Explore dark hospital rooms and corridors, find keys, and use your flashlight and tools. Read notes, keep a journal, interact with your surroundings, and piece together fragments of a forgotten story.

Every detail could hold a piece of the truth.

NOTHING IS QUITE WHAT IT SEEMS.

Something roams the corridors. Voices warn you of danger. But can you trust them?

Your choices have consequences, and fear doesn't always lead you to the right decision.

Sometimes, the greatest threat is your own perception.

FIVE CYCLES. ONE TRUTH.

Five cycles. A changing hospital. Choices that can send you back to the beginning.

Why did you end up in Room 017? Who is controlling what happens here? And what exactly are you trying to remember?

In the end, only one choice remains.

Everything on the belt is a real object with an actual size. If a slab is three cells wide, it needs three lanes to move. Sometimes you'll rotate a piece just to squeeze it through a tight spot. Sometimes you won't, and it'll sit there clogging everything behind it.




Play in 2D or 3D. Switch whenever you like and the factory keeps running exactly as it was. Spin the camera round a jam to see what’s stuck, or pull back and watch the whole thing move.

Make your factory run like CLOCKWORK without CLOGGING the lanes. Clog-work. Get it? Glue, cut, rotate and transport pieces to the Hub. Optimise your designs, push your score higher, and see how you compare with other players on the in-game leaderboards.

Filter by colour, size, or number of cells. Decide what gets cut, what gets pushed, and what gets left alone. You can hook almost anything into the logic layer and control when it acts. There's no single way to solve a problem. How you build it is up to you. And yes, there is dark mode.

The demo gives you three figures to build, ending with a more complex house where you'll need to get both the shape and colours right. There's no time limit, so take as long as you need to work it out. The full game has many more tiers, eventually working your way up to pieces as large as 32x32. The demo also has 33 Puzzles levels, and the full game has 94.

  • More content: Many more figures to build, with shapes that get harder to crack.

  • Puzzles: 94 levels to solve, from simple belts to logic circuits.

  • In-game leaderboards: The first 10 seeds each have their own leaderboard. Pick a figure and see how far you can push your throughput.

    When you play the full game with Steam available, your score and an encrypted replay proof of your factory's scoring window are uploaded to Steam so I can check the result on my PC; only I hold the private key needed to open the proof. You can turn off future uploads with ‘Leaderboard uploads’ in Settings.

  • Steam Workshop: Create and share your own target figures, or download figures made by other players.

  • Achievements: Just achievements. To show that you know what you're doing.

  • Screenshot mode: Take one huge screenshot of your entire factory. Really large maps may need to be split into several images or exported at a lower resolution.

CLOGWORK is made by one developer. I'll keep updating it after launch.

"Go now, Lityria. This is the path you chose."

Four hundred years ago, six hundred people left Earth.

Their ship is still out there, somewhere in the middle of the crossing.

They are still asleep — and what they are seeing is a single shared dream, managed by the ship's AI.

The world has been replaced many times over. With each one, they have lived as someone else, an entire life at a time.

This is the last of those dreams.

Lityria sets out remembering nothing — not even what it is she has forgotten.

Driven by a restlessness she cannot explain, with two companions at her side.

Twelve labyrinths lie scattered across the world, and at the bottom of each is a key to the seal that holds it shut.

Every key she recovers returns a little more of who she used to be.

A story about a mother and a daughter, told across an enormous distance in time and space.

Twelve labyrinths, twelve pieces of the truth

Find and clear the twelve labyrinths scattered across the world, and the shape of this place slowly comes into focus.

Why are we here?

What is waiting at the end of all this walking?

And when everything is finally clear — do we still have to go?

Gear you grow by exploring

Ore and gemstones found in the field and underground are what make your party stronger.

  • Swords and bracelets evolve across ten elements and four tiers — forty variants in total

  • Higher upgrade levels raise more than attack and defence, boosting a range of stats

  • Progression comes from walking the world, not only from winning fights

Every new skill opens the map further

Offer Crystal Stones at the goddess statues scattered across the world to learn magic and sword arts.

Clearing a labyrinth unlocks traversal abilities — shattering rock, crossing elevation, moving machinery, clearing blocked paths. Places you could only look at become places you can reach, and the world keeps widening.

380 hand-built maps that change as you travel

Dawn, midday, dusk, night. Clear skies, light rain, storms, blizzards.

The landscape shifts constantly with the hour and the weather.

Underground rivers and lakes, ice caves, lava flows, crystal caverns, total darkness — every region hides something different below it, and at the end of each waits a labyrinth with its own theme and its own puzzles.

Free demo — out now

The demo is available now, free, covering the opening of the game through the first labyrinth.

  • Playtime: About 1 hour (around 2 hours if you explore)

  • Price: Free

  • Languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, Brazilian Portuguese

About the developer

Closed World: Memories of a Fleeting World is made by Stilhearts, a solo independent developer in Japan, using SmileBoom's 3D RPG Developer BAKIN.

It is their second title, following Closed World: Story of a Sealed World, released on Steam in August 2024.

Open the pages, and instantly step into real-world destinations brought to life through advanced Gaussian Splatting technology.

Cloud Journey is a VR cultural tourism experience that uses Gaussian Splatting as its core technology. You are no longer just a viewer — you truly walk into the landscapes:

  • Ultra-Realistic Visual Immersion Powered by the most advanced Gaussian Splatting technology, experience breathtakingly realistic 3D reconstructions with natural lighting and intricate details. Whether it's the misty rain over Jiangnan water towns or the strange and wondrous rock formations deep in the mountains, every scene delivers an unprecedented sense of presence and spatial depth.

Codename: Operation Go is a turn-based tactical strategy game that blends the rules of Go, the combat of a tactical wargame, and the visual presentation of a tabletop strategy game.

Unlike traditional tactical games, units do not need to spend their movement advancing from the rear to the front. As in Go, you can deploy units directly to any available position on the battlefield, send them into action immediately, and capture enemy forces outright by surrounding them.

Your reinforcements can appear wherever they are needed most—but enemy forces can threaten your rear just as suddenly. Traditional front lines no longer hold. A new front may emerge within a single turn, only to collapse in the next. Every action becomes a tactical decision of both space and timing.

Deploy Straight into Battle

Units can be deployed directly to any available position on the battlefield instead of advancing step by step from the rear toward the front.

Newly deployed units can enter the fight immediately, while forces already in play can be redeployed to other sectors to keep pace with a rapidly changing battle.

A threatened flank. Exposed heavy weapons in the rear. An isolated command post. Any of them can become the key to turning the tide—and opportunities rarely last for long.

In war, there is no fixed disposition and no constant form.

Divide and Encircle

Destroying the enemy head-on is not your only path to victory. Just as in Go, you can eliminate entire groups of enemy units by cutting them off and surrounding them.

Sever their connections. Compress their space. Divide their forces and close the encirclement.

A blocked route, an isolated formation, or an outpost cut off from the main force can cause an otherwise solid defensive line to collapse. Tear open an enemy formation and defeat it piece by piece, or use terrain and deployment to tighten the encirclement until there is nowhere left to retreat.

But the enemy can do exactly the same to you. Every move is therefore part of a larger tactical contest.

Engage with the orthodox; win with the unorthodox.

Combined Arms

Tanks break through the line. Artillery delivers supporting fire. Paratroopers strike where they are least expected. Infantry excel in the close confines of urban combat.

Every unit has its own place on the battlefield.

Each turn allows multiple unit actions and tactical actions, giving different forces the opportunity to work together in tightly coordinated sequences. One unit creates an opening; another exploits it. Individual strengths combine into a complete fighting system, producing results far greater than any unit could achieve alone.

The skilled warrior seeks victory from the situation, not from individual men; thus he chooses the right men and lets the situation work.

Turn Terrain to Your Advantage

Victory is never decided by numbers alone. Terrain is part of the battle.

Open plains become steel meat grinders where opposing forces collide head-on. Dense forests conceal troops from threats overhead. Rugged mountains favor those who hold the high ground.

Rivers and swamps form natural barriers that can halt an offensive and redirect entire lines of advance. Cities, factories, and airfields become forests of steel—providing both a steady flow of reinforcements and valuable shelter for their defenders.

Learning to use the ground itself can matter more than simply bringing more troops.

“The natural formation of the country is the soldier’s best ally.”

An Ever-Expanding Battlefield

A battle begins in only one corner of the map, then pushes outward as new sectors of the battlefield are opened.

With each advance come new enemies, new terrain, and new situations. Objectives may change as the battle develops.

What first appears to be a successful offensive may lead your forces into a far more complicated situation. Behind every newly revealed sector may lie a fresh threat—or an unexpected opportunity.

You must continually reassess the battlefield, redeploy your forces, and change the direction of your operations if you hope to remain one step ahead.

Do not repeat the tactics that gained you one victory; let your methods adapt to the infinite variety of circumstances.

Command the Battlefield from the Tabletop

The visual design of Codename: Operation Go deliberately evokes the feeling of a tabletop wargame.

Each battlefield resembles a physical game board laid out on a table, while military units become the pieces with which you contest the battle.

On this small tabletop, you will lay your plans within the command tent—and decide victory a thousand miles away.

A Campaign That Builds Step by Step

New mechanics are introduced gradually through story dialogue, tutorials, and mission objectives.

As the campaign progresses, you will encounter new units, terrain, tactical abilities, and increasingly complex battlefield situations.

Each mission is an unfolding tactical puzzle:

Read the situation. Deploy your forces. Complete the objective. Open the next battlefield. And ultimately, secure victory.

Key Features

  • Go-inspired free deployment — deploy units directly to any available position on the battlefield instead of advancing them from a rear base.

  • Divide and encircle — cut enemy forces apart, compress their space, surround them, and capture entire formations using rules inspired by Go.

  • Rapidly shifting front lines — reinforcements can appear at critical positions at any moment, while yesterday’s rear area can become today’s front line.

  • Multi-unit coordination — chain multiple unit and tactical actions together within a single turn, allowing different forces to create opportunities for one another.

  • 12 distinctive unit types — command infantry, tanks, artillery, fortifications, paratroopers, and other units, each with its own tactical role.

  • 4 tactical abilities — influence the battlefield beyond ordinary unit actions with additional options for offense, defense, support, and counterplay.

  • Terrain is strategy — forests, mountains, rivers, swamps, cities, factories, and airfields all reshape the battlefield and the tactics available to you.

  • An ever-expanding battlefield — advance from one sector to the next as new enemies, terrain, objectives, threats, and opportunities emerge.

  • Tabletop-inspired presentation — fight across battlefields designed to resemble physical wargame boards laid out on a table.

  • Hex-grid turn-based tactics — fight for the initiative through deployment, positioning, routes, formations, terrain, and encirclement.

  • A progressively deepening single-player campaign — new units, mechanics, objectives, and battlefield situations are introduced naturally through missions, story, and tutorials.

Coilbound is a dark fantasy roguelike about reading your enemies before you fight them. You descend a single coiling tunnel into the dark, and at every step the dungeon offers you two cards — one to the left, one to the right. Attack, or slip past. Every enemy is a puzzle of traits

And immortality, which does exactly what it says. The traits sit on the card as small icons; click one and it opens into a full rule. It doesn't die when it dies

Descend, or don't

Coilbound is built to keep that tension alive on every single turn — there is no dominant strategy waiting to be solved, only the enemy in front of you and the two cards in your hands.

Multiply faster. Move faster. Improve your toxins.

How you evolve changes how you survive.

■ The Human Body Is Your Battleground

Travel through the throat, lungs, bloodstream, heart, brain, digestive tract, and beyond.

Every organ presents a different challenge. Get swept away by breathing in the lungs, carried by currents in the bloodstream, or pushed around by intestinal peristalsis.

White blood cells aren't your only threat.

The human body itself is trying to stop you.

Adapt to each environment and venture deeper and deeper inside.

■ Don't Fear Antibiotics

After three minutes, a massive wave of antibiotics sweeps across the stage.

Running alone won't be enough to survive.

Sometimes, you must expose your colony to antibiotics, sacrifice some of your bacteria, and develop resistance for the final onslaught.

Run. Multiply. Evolve.

Whatever it takes to keep the colony alive.

■ In Search of a Place to Call Home

If you don't multiply, you won't survive.
But multiply too much, and you'll harm your host—and destroy the very place you need to live.

Can stability and prosperity ever truly coexist?

A tiny colony of bacteria sets out on a journey through the human body, searching for a place where it can finally live in peace.

Voice: Yui Akiyama
